## Top 10 Hardest Upgrades / Fixes (full audit — do not remove items, only strikethrough when done)

| # | Issue | Severity | What makes it hard |
|---|-------|----------|--------------------|
| ~~1~~ | ~~**Dual Seam Layout Fragmentation (ImageGenerationSeam)** — legacy flat adapter/mock/fixtures existed alongside the self-contained seam as dead code; test used wrong config type; seam registry had two conflicting rows~~ | ~~CRITICAL~~ | ~~Requires verifying all callers before deletion, reconciling two seam layers, fixing test type mismatches, updating the registry without breaking the API-contract layer that still lives in `contracts/image-generation.contract.ts`~~ |
| 2 | **No Startup Validation for Required Env Vars** — `hooks.server.ts` does not exist; app boots silently without `XAI_API_KEY` etc. and fails only on the first live request; `meechie-studio-text-pipeline.ts` reads `env.XAI_TEXT_MODEL` at module load time, completely bypassing AppConfigSeam | CRITICAL | Must understand SvelteKit server lifecycle, decide required vs optional per-feature, handle graceful degradation for optional features (wig try-on), not break tests |
| 3 | **Retry Logic: No Circuit Breaker + Incorrect `Retry-After` Cap** — `fetchWithRetry` caps `Retry-After` at 30 s regardless of what the server sends; no circuit breaker means a prolonged xAI outage causes 10–30 s hangs instead of fast-fail 503s | HIGH | Circuit breaker requires new stateful resilience abstraction; changing the cap risks compliance issues if xAI changes defaults; adding metrics requires a new seam or DI |
| 4 | **Type Safety: Silent JSON Parse Failures + Lossy Error Truncation** — `generate-pipeline.ts` silently swallows `.json()` parse errors; `meechie-studio-text-pipeline.ts` truncates provider error responses to 500 chars before logging | HIGH | JSON extraction fallbacks are intentional (some providers wrap JSON in prose); removing them risks breaking real flows; adding proper typed error preservation touches multiple pipeline files |
| 5 | **`XAI_TEXT_MODEL` Direct `env` Read Bypasses Seam + Startup** — `meechie-studio-text-pipeline.ts:16` calls `selectTextModel(env.XAI_TEXT_MODEL)` at module load time outside any seam or validation guard | HIGH | Fixing requires routing the text-model key through AppConfigSeam or a new `TextProviderConfigSeam`; module-level side-effect must be converted to a lazy call; all call-sites and tests must be updated |
| 6 | **`localStorage` Quota / Private-Mode Errors Uncaught** — `session.adapter.ts` and `creation-store.adapter.ts` call `localStorage.setItem/getItem/removeItem` without try/catch; quota errors in private-mode Safari or full-storage contexts bubble as unhandled 500s | MEDIUM | Requires a graceful fallback (in-memory cache); seam contracts need a new error code path; tests currently mock localStorage so quota errors are never exercised |
| 7 | **Service Worker Bundle: No Automated Zod Exclusion Check** — `src/service-worker.ts` relative-imports the cache adapter; `plan.md` notes a manual Vite bundle check to confirm Zod is absent, but there is no CI enforcement | MEDIUM | Service worker bundling depends on Vite/SvelteKit internals; adding a build-time bundle-size assertion requires modifying `vite.config.ts` or a custom rollup plugin |
| 8 | **Dependency-Injected Seams Have No Adapter — Registry Misleads** — `PromptCompilerSeam`, `SafetyPolicySeam`, `GalleryStoreSeam`, `TelemetrySeam` are listed in `docs/seams.md` with `Adapter: N/A (dependency-injected seam)`, making it impossible for a new developer to tell whether a seam is "ready to wire" or "design-only" | MEDIUM | Deciding whether to add real adapters (over-engineering for pure functions) vs. marking them explicitly as "pure / no adapter by design" requires understanding SDD intent for each seam; registry and CLAUDE.md need a new vocabulary |
| 9 | **Blocked Probes — No Live Evidence for `ImageGenerationSeam` + `WigTryOnSeam`** — Both seams are wired to production routes but have `TBD (blocked)` probe status; fixtures are code-only (never validated against real xAI/Gemini responses); if either API changed its response shape the adapters would fail at runtime undetected | MEDIUM | Requires xAI + Gemini API keys; fixtures must be ≤7 days fresh per AGENTS.md; if probes fail, contracts and adapters must be rewritten |
| 10 | **Svelte 5 Migration Incomplete** — `+page.svelte` was migrated to runes (`$state`, `$derived`); 20+ components in `src/lib/components/` were not audited; legacy `$:` reactive statements and `on:` event directives may coexist with runes, creating inconsistent patterns | MEDIUM | No automated fixer exists; some components have complex reactivity that is non-trivial to convert; `svelte-check` currently passes so the inconsistency is silent |

---

## What this PR does (item 1)

**Problem — three layers of fragmentation:**

1. `src/lib/adapters/image-generation.adapter.ts` — a legacy client-side adapter that calls `/api/image-generation` via `fetch`. No callers existed after the self-contained seam (`src/lib/adapters/image-generation-seam/index.ts`) became the live server-side implementation. Dead code.

2. `src/lib/mocks/image-generation.mock.ts` — the legacy mock for the flat-layout seam. Also dead; its only imports were the legacy JSON fixtures.

3. `fixtures/image-generation/{sample,fault,dense-scene}.json` — three JSON fixtures only referenced by the dead mock above.

4. `tests/contract/image-generation.test.ts` — the test had already been migrated to the new seam (`createMockImageGenerationSeam`, `createImageGenerationSeam`) but still imported `AppConfigSeam` (10 fields) and passed it to `createImageGenerationSeam` which expects `ImageProviderConfigSeam` (4 xAI-image-only fields). TypeScript structural subtyping silently accepted it, hiding the mismatch.

5. `docs/seams.md` — two rows for `ImageGenerationSeam`: one pointing to the legacy flat layout (with now-deleted adapter/mock/fixtures), one pointing to the self-contained layout. Developers couldn't tell which was canonical.

**Changes:**
- Deleted `src/lib/adapters/image-generation.adapter.ts`
- Deleted `src/lib/mocks/image-generation.mock.ts`
- Deleted `fixtures/image-generation/` (3 JSON files)
- Fixed `tests/contract/image-generation.test.ts`: `AppConfigSeam` → `ImageProviderConfigSeam`; config object trimmed to the 4 keys the narrow seam actually needs
- Collapsed `docs/seams.md` to one canonical `ImageGenerationSeam` row; added note that API-level schemas remain in `contracts/image-generation.contract.ts`

**Verification:** 419 tests pass, `svelte-check` reports 0 errors/warnings.

Consolidate the ImageGenerationSeam onto the self-contained implementation and remove the legacy flat adapter/mocks/fixtures while correcting its contract test configuration and registry entry.

Bug Fixes:
- Update the image generation contract test to use ImageProviderConfigSeam with the minimal required config fields instead of the broader AppConfigSeam, eliminating a silent type mismatch.

Enhancements:
- Simplify the seams registry documentation to a single canonical ImageGenerationSeam entry that points to the self-contained seam and clarifies where API-level schemas live.

Chores:
- Remove dead image generation adapter, mock, and JSON fixtures that were superseded by the self-contained ImageGenerationSeam.
